digest.en: US President Trump announced hostilities in Iran have terminated. The US will withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany amid escalating tensions with NATO allies over the Iran war. Gas prices in the US jumped to $4.39 per gallon in the largest one-day increase since the Iran ceasefire was announced.
